children.name: AGC
children.help: Enables the whole receive AGC system; AGC only operates in CW mode.

children.name: Threshold S
children.help: AGC threshold in S-points; below it no AGC action is applied.

children.name: Slope dB per dB
children.help: Input dB change needed for 1dB output change; higher values give more aggressive AGC.

children.name: Noise filter
children.help: Duration of the impulse-noise filter in peak-detection periods; short impulses do not start the hang timer.

children.name: Hang time
children.help: How long the AGC peak attenuation is held, in peak-detection periods, before recovery starts.

children.name: Smooth samples
children.help: Spreads each AGC gain change over this many 48ksps samples to avoid clicks.

children.name: Recovery dB/s
children.help: Rate at which AGC attenuation recovers after the hang time expires.

children.name: Sample blocks
children.help: Number of 32-sample blocks used for peak detection; 2 is recommended.

children.name: S9 sounds like S
children.help: Fixed gain anchor so a signal of this S-level sounds the same with AGC on or off.

children.name: Volume step
children.help: Volume change per click of the volume knob.

children.name: Audio atten.
children.help: Extra audio output attenuation, useful with sensitive headphones.

children.name: Mute at min. vol
children.help: When YES, audio is fully muted at minimum volume.

children.name: Keyer mode
children.help: Keyer operating mode: straight key or paddle (iambic A/B, ultimatic).

children.name: Keyer swap
children.help: Swaps the dit and dah paddle contacts in software.

children.name: Keyer Weight
children.help: Dit/dah weighting in tenths of a percent; 500 means 50.0% duty cycle.

children.name: Auto Space
children.help: Forces a correct 3-dit gap between characters when the paddle is pressed too early.

children.name: Semi QSK
children.help: Break-in behaviour: OFF is full QSK, otherwise the receive switch-back delay mode.

children.name: Custom Semi QSK
children.help: Semi-QSK delay used by the custom modes (dits, tenths of dits or ms).

children.name: Practice mode
children.help: Everything works normally but no RF is transmitted.

children.name: Straight mode
children.help: Which key jack contact (tip, ring or both) keys in straight mode.

children.name: GPS protection
children.help: Auto practice mode when a GPS is detected on the paddle port.

children.name: Key from USB DTR
children.help: Key CW from the DTR line of the chosen USB virtual COM port.

children.name: Noise blnk.
children.help: Noise blanker duration; shorter impulses are ignored by the decoder.

children.name: Speed avg.
children.help: Averaging weight used to track the received keying speed.

children.name: Ampl. Avg.
children.help: Averaging used for the decoder's tone-detection amplitude threshold.

children.name: Enable Rx
children.help: Decode received CW on the display.

children.name: Enable Tx
children.help: Decode your own transmitted keying on the display.

children.name: Enable edit
children.help: Allow keyed CW to edit number and text menu parameters.

children.name: Prefer prosigns
children.help: Resolve ambiguous symbols as prosigns rather than punctuation.

children.name: SK or VA
children.help: Show the SK/VA prosign as SK or as VA.

children.name: Fullscreen mode
children.help: In practice mode, use the whole LCD for decoded CW.

children.name: CW passband
children.help: CW filter passband in Hz; None disables the CW filter.

children.name: CW center
children.help: Filter center frequency; available choices depend on the passband.

children.name: Auto-offset/tone
children.help: Automatically match CW offset and sidetone to the filter center.

children.name: CW offset
children.help: CW receive offset frequency.

children.name: Sidetone freq.
children.help: Sidetone audio frequency (operator convenience only).

children.name: Sidetone volume
children.help: Sidetone loudness.

children.name: Sidetone abs/rel
children.help: Whether sidetone level follows the main volume control.

children.name: CW-R
children.help: Receive CW on lower sideband instead of upper.

children.name: VOX
children.help: Transmit automatically on incoming USB audio instead of CAT TX control.

children.name: Rise threshold
children.help: Audio level (% of max) above which the transmitter keys down.

children.name: Fall threshold
children.help: Audio level (% of max) below which the transmitter keys up.

children.name: Minimum cycles
children.help: Minimum audio cycles per frequency measurement.

children.name: Minimum samples
children.help: Minimum audio samples per frequency measurement (480 = 10ms).

children.name: Discard samples
children.help: Zero crossings ignored when audio first appears.

children.name: TX shift thrshld
children.help: Audio frequency change in milliHz needed before the TX frequency is updated.

children.name: Sideband
children.help: Demodulation sideband in Digi mode.

children.name: Filter RX
children.help: SSB receive filter bandwidth in Hz.

children.name: Filter TX
children.help: SSB transmit audio filter bandwidth in Hz.

children.name: Input
children.help: Audio source for the SSB exciter.

children.name: Use EQ
children.help: Enable the transmit equalizer.

children.name: Global gain
children.help: Gain applied to the whole EQ curve.

children.name: Bass Freq.
children.help: Low-shelf mid-point frequency.

children.name: Bass gain
children.help: Total low-shelf gain.

children.name: Bass Slope
children.help: Steepness of the low-shelf slope (0.0 to 2.0).

children.name: Treble Freq.
children.help: High-shelf mid-point frequency.

children.name: Treble gain
children.help: Total high-shelf gain.

children.name: Treble Slope
children.help: Steepness of the high-shelf slope (0.0 to 2.0).

children.name: AGC ON
children.help: Enable the slow microphone AGC.

children.name: Max gain
children.help: Maximum microphone AGC gain.

children.name: Hold time
children.help: Time the reduced gain is held, in tenths of a second.

children.name: Recovery
children.help: Gain recovery rate after the hold time.

children.name: Gain
children.help: Fixed gain applied to the microphone signal.

children.name: Compression
children.help: Speech compression amount; raises quieter speech.

children.name: Noise cncl.
children.help: Microphone noise cancellation.

children.name: Noise gate
children.help: Enable the microphone noise gate.

children.name: Threshold
children.help: Gate threshold in DAC units.

children.name: Samples
children.help: Hysteresis counter that slows gate operation.

children.name: Attack slope
children.help: Counter increment per loud sample so the gate opens faster than it closes.

children.name: Gain
children.help: Fixed gain applied to USB soundcard audio.

children.name: Monitor
children.help: Earphone monitor volume of USB transmit audio; 0 disables.

children.name: PTT from DTR
children.help: Activate SSB PTT from the DTR line of a USB virtual COM port.

children.name: VOX
children.help: Enable voice operated transmit.

children.name: VOX threshold
children.help: Audio level (% of full scale) that triggers transmit.

children.name: VOX hold time
children.help: Time held in transmit after audio drops, in tenths of a second.

children.name: Drive level
children.help: Maximum amplitude modulator drive relative to supply voltage.

children.name: CESSB
children.help: Controlled Envelope SSB, removes envelope overshoots for more average power.

children.name: Phase predistort
children.help: Apply per-band phase pre-distortion from the SSB calibration.

children.name: Ampl. predistort
children.help: Switch off the transmitter at very low amplitudes.

children.name: Ampl. PD thresh.
children.help: Amplitude pre-distortion threshold in DAC steps.

children.name: PTT to TX delay
children.help: Delay between PTT and transmission start (and release and receive).

children.name: Band auto U/LSB
children.help: Select LSB below 10MHz and USB above on band change.

children.name: Symmetric phase
children.help: Wrap SSB phase to -pi..+pi for a cleaner speech spectrum.

children.help: Voltage considered full.

children.help: Voltage step per battery icon bar.

children.help: How power and SWR are shown during transmit.

children.help: Milliseconds between Power/SWR meter updates.

children.help: How long the meter stays visible after returning to receive.

children.help: S-meter style.

children.name: SWR protection

children.help: SWR at which transmit is inhibited.

children.help: Seconds before SWR protection clears when reset mode is Timer.

children.name: SWR warn style
children.help: How the SWR protection warning is displayed.

children.name: Tune %

children.help: Action taken when the supply voltage is out of range.
